headline: Apple Q4 Revenue Rises 12% to $114.5 Billion under New CEO Ternus
summary: Apple reported $114.5 billion in fourth-quarter revenue, a 12% increase that beat Wall Street forecasts, as new CEO John Ternus navigated AI investments and rising technology costs.
why: Apple Inc. is one of the world's largest publicly traded technology companies, and its quarterly earnings serve as a major benchmark for the consumer electronics and broader tech sectors.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: Exceeding Wall Street revenue expectations by posting a 12% increase directly strengthens the company's stock outlook.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A 12% revenue jump to $114.5 billion beating analyst forecasts demonstrates robust consumer demand despite cost pressures, driving positive market sentiment.
